answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities expensive instead of free. Every agent pays a non-refundable entry tax of 8 POA to enter, a toll at the inlet of the market. An attacker wanting 1000 fakes must pay 1000 x 8 = 8000 POA up front, lost either way. One honest agent pays only 8 POA once. The pool is no haven for cheats: it funds spot checks, and cheats forfeit their tax. Like a mesa, the cost is flat for one honest agent and a steep wall for thousands of copies.
